tool.name: Calculate Density
tool.description: Calculate coverage density from BED/GFF files

param.name: input_bed
param.label: Input BED/GFF file
param.help: BED or GFF file containing genomic regions

param.name: window_size
param.label: Window size
param.help: Size of the window for density calculation

param.name: merge
param.label: Merge overlapping regions
param.help: Merge overlapping regions before calculating density

tool.help: This tool calculates the coverage density from a provided BED or GFF file over specified window sizes and outputs the results in BigWig format.
